items.label: General harvest
items.note: Harvest in Ethiopia begins in October each year and ends early January the following year it is called 'Meher harvest' and it is considered the main crop season. The meher harvest occurs only in western agricultural areas (Gambala, South West, Benishangul-Gumuz, Amhara and SNNPR) and belg receiving areas (Afar, Oromia, SNNPR, Sidama, Somali and Tigray).

items.label: Malaria
items.note: The number of malaria cases tend to increase with the start of the rainy season and floods, peaking towards the later part of the flooding season (August-September). Stagnant water pools following rains and flooding result in the propagation of mosquitoes – the vectors of malaria and other diseases.
